description: This file contains utility functions for interacting with the Ollama API, including connection checking, streaming processing, and model pulling, with retry logic and progress bar updates.

methods.name: check_connection
methods.description: Checks if the Ollama client can successfully list models, indicating a working connection.

methods.name: process_streaming
methods.description: Processes a streaming generator of model download progress, updating progress bars accordingly.

methods.name: pull_model
methods.description: Pulls a specified model from Ollama if not already installed, with progress updates.
